ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity cream/off-white pixels occupy approximately 75% of the visible surface, with low-intensity black pixels forming a 25% distribution primarily along the perimeter and central junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity region centered on both lobes; low-intensity continuous border (5-20 pixel width) along trailing edges. Distinct low-intensity oval spot at mid-left lobe. Dark vertical pigmentation wedge at the central notch/peduncle interface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; interior angle approximately 50-60 degrees with a vertical depth of roughly 1/6th the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; notably larger jagged indentations on the distal 10% of both the left and right lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge leading from the notch to the distal tips, which terminate in sharp, posteriorly-angled points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Single distinct high-intensity circular pixel cluster (scar) on the interior left lobe; small clusters of high-contrast white nodules (barnacles) attached to the furthest lateral edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of three distinct, parallel, low-intensity horizontal linear tracks (rake marks) situated on the right lobe near the medial notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible rake marks on the medial right lobe; multiple micro-amputations/chips along the trailing edge topography giving it a ragged appearance.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique yellowish-tan tint to the high-intensity regions compared to pure white; dark splotch at the 10 o'clock position on the left lobe.
